cohort: Every entry in historical-zone-study-results.json, no selection by outcome
underlying_exit: 15m horizon at zero stock cost; stop/target levels fixed at entry
contract_selection: nearest expiry 7-14 calendar DTE, then nearest strike to decision-time stock price; tie ITM side; calls for long, puts for short; standard 100-share contracts
exit_delay: one minute after the underlying trigger is observable; a touch becomes observable after its complete minute
data: actual option minute trade-bar opens, not bid/ask quotes
missing_bars: exclude price reference and report separately; never carry forward
promotion: none; diagnostic only; no actual execution or profitability claim
